title: "Hydration breaks" can help the "beautiful game" become a beautiful business

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: "Hydration breaks" can help the "beautiful game" become a beautiful business
sources.description: The 2026 World Cup has seen the "hydration break" become a point of contention, with in-stadium fans repeatedly booing (and the FIFA-fearful broadcasters not inclined to mention it) and Fox laughing all the way to the bank.
